firstPlayerRule: The person who last combed a cat places the neutral cats during setup. Their opponent takes the first turn.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The setup player places one brown Neutral Cat on a Region tile of each color.
The two players then alternate gameplay turns. The cat-combing criterion selects the setup player, not the first active player.
